artworks.title: Monolith IV: Ocean Fog
artworks.medium: Archival Carbon Pigment on Hahnemühle Photo Rag 308g
artworks.description: An isolated monolithic concrete sea pavilion emerging through thick Atlantic sea smoke at dawn. Captured with an 8x10 large format field camera over a continuous 14-minute exposure.
artworks.curatorialNotes: In 'Monolith IV', the brutalist mass dissolves into oceanic haze, transforming heavy cast concrete into an ethereal ghost of modernist ambition.
awards: International Fine Art Photography Monograph Gold, 2025

artworks.title: Quantum Chromodynamics III: Indigo Rift
artworks.medium: Direct UV-Curable Print on Brushed Aluminium Dibond, Matt Finish
artworks.description: A computational synthesis of quantum field fluctuations rendered as continuous topological light manifolds. The dark void background contrasts with ribbons of cobalt, deep indigo, and icy titanium.
artworks.curatorialNotes: Generated through custom C++ simulation shaders that calculate the interaction between light waves and virtual magnetic fluxes across multi-dimensional manifolds.

technicalDetails.cameraOrEngine: Bespoke C++ / Metal Fluid Dynamic Shaders

awards: Lumen Prize Nominee for Pure Computational Art, 2025

artworks.title: Basalt Tower in Arctic Twilight
artworks.medium: Platinum-Palladium Print on Hand-Coated Japanese Washi Paper
artworks.description: A single volcanic basalt needle rising sheer from the North Atlantic surf off the Vik coast during polar night, reflecting faint silver ambient twilight on glassy water.
artworks.curatorialNotes: Hand-printed by the artist in his Berlin darkroom using precious platinum and palladium salts, achieving rich luminous midtones impossible in standard silver processes.

technicalDetails.fileSpec: Contact printed directly from 4x5 sheet negative

artworks.title: Algorithmic Flora IX: Filament Lattice
artworks.medium: Face-Mounted Museum Acrylic Glass on Diasec Aluminium Substrate
artworks.description: Intricate recursive crystalline geometries emulating the vascular architecture of deep-sea bioluminescent organisms suspended in an obsidian vacuum.
artworks.curatorialNotes: Explores the philosophical boundary between organic growth and deterministic computation, presenting mathematically generated organisms that feel undeniably alive.

technicalDetails.cameraOrEngine: Recursive Differential Growth Algorithm in Rust

artworks.title: Cantilever in Rain, Berlin V
artworks.medium: Archival Pigment on Hahnemühle FineArt Baryta 325g
artworks.description: A study of reinforced concrete brutalism in deep Berlin rain. The wet surface reflects street sodium light, turning planar concrete into a mirror of urban solitude.
artworks.curatorialNotes: A masterwork of geometric framing, balancing heavy horizontal cantilevers against delicate vertical streaks of rain.

technicalDetails.cameraOrEngine: Leica S3 Medium Format / Summarit-S 70mm f/2.5 ASPH
technicalDetails.lensOrAlgorithm: ISO 100, f/11, 2.5s exposure on Gitzo carbon tripod

artworks.title: Event Horizon: Zero Point
artworks.medium: Ultra-Matte Archival Carbon Print in Custom Steel Shadowbox Frame
artworks.description: An exploration of absolute blackness and the minimal threshold of visible light. The composition features a singularity ring rendered at the limit of human perception.
artworks.curatorialNotes: When viewed in controlled gallery lighting, the artwork creates the optical illusion of physical depth receding infinitely past the wall surface.

technicalDetails.cameraOrEngine: Custom General Relativity Gravitational Lensing Code
